title: Harvest Record Request Form
subtitle: Harvest Record: defines need, constraints, and assignment.
description: Harvest Record Request Form covers crop, field or block, harvest crew, container, quantity, condition, lot, and receiving handoff. The harvest operations owner records Harvest Record need, timing, access, and assignment. Harvest Record Request Form keeps Harvest Record exceptions visible until the harvest operations owner handoff.
use_case: Use Harvest Record Request Form at field, block, harvest zone, loading point, and receiving or cooling location. Document crop, field or block, harvest crew, container, quantity, condition, lot, and receiving handoff identity before Harvest Record begins. Compare crop, field or block, harvest crew, container, quantity, condition, lot, and receiving handoff findings with stated Harvest Record criteria; route unresolved Harvest Record issues to farm production reviewer.

sections.title: Requester, location, and subject details
sections.guidance: For Harvest Record, identify responsible parties, field, block, harvest zone, loading point, and receiving or cooling location, and the linked crop, field or block, harvest crew, container, quantity, condition, lot, and receiving handoff source.

sections.guidance: Resolve open Harvest Record request questions; have harvest operations owner record the assignment, response owner, and requester follow-up while keeping the record strictly at the intake and routing stage.

blocks.guidance: Do not assign or authorize the Harvest Record request when lot identity, crop condition, quantity, cooling, or receiving custody remains unresolved. Retain information supplied with the request and route unresolved constraints to harvest operations owner.
